overall_verdict.description: Overall assessment of the audited artifact.

data_and_usability_summary.description: First-principles summary focusing on data accuracy, logic soundness, and end-to-end usability.

self_review_notes.description: Mandatory self-critique confirming every issue has concrete evidence, is non-trivial, and has feasible fix & Pass/Fail criteria.

blocked_needs_human.description: True if this issue cannot be resolved by editing files alone (e.g., needs business decision, missing runtime env, or external official files).

human_support_needed.description: What decision, file, or environment support is required from the user when blocked_needs_human is true; empty string otherwise.
